No realistic fur, no design changes.
Output exactly TWO full-body standing dogs only, side by side on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha, canvas 1536x1024. Each dog occupies its own 768x1024 half. Nemo (apricot cream, wide white forehead blaze) left facing down-right; Dori (chocolate, cream eyebrow dots and muzzle, no forehead blaze) right facing down-right. Same three-quarter angle and neutral stance as Image1. NO additional poses or sprite sheet. Both triangular ears upright, BOTH cream forepaws visibly OUTSIDE clothing in front at chest level, small gap between the two paws; a short visible arm/cuff connects each paw to its own shoulder. No missing/overlapping/hidden hands, no held staff or gun. Shoulder bags may hang at hip. Exactly two hands and two feet on EACH dog. Preserve tiny costume ornamentation.
Registration inside EACH half: feet baseline y930, natural ear tips around y140, eye centers around y430, shoulder line y580, paw centers y675. Same head/body proportions and body height for both dogs, across the whole costume set. Headgear can extend slightly above ears but must not shrink body. Center torso x390, tail extends left. Leave generous transparent margin around all edges; no clipping.
